scope: Only the two completed real Sonnet native Messages runs: cashflow-source-r2 and business-source. Earlier failed cashflow-source run is excluded.

definitions.invalid_json: Saved visible text fails strict json.loads; not every invalid_model_decision is this class.
definitions.local_pydantic_or_business_schema_failur: JSON parses, but a local AutonomousDecision/nested-model validator rejects it before a host action.
definitions.host_action_precondition_rejection: A typed decision was returned; host rejects a missing requirement association before tool execution.
definitions.redundant_navigation: Successful navigation repeated identical already available content with no progress.
definitions.productive_under_current_protocol: Accepted setup, planning, evidence acquisition, packaging or finish step that advanced this observed run. This is not a proven minimum number of calls.

observations: Both runs show the same early pattern: query skill; plan without reason; repaired plan; JSON formatting failure; outline without requirement_ids; repaired outline. This repetition supports a protocol-communication hypothesis rather than a source-specific retrieval failure.
Five typed tool decisions omit requirement_ids. Current wire schema defaults this field to an empty array, while the host requires a nonempty existing association for these tool actions.

Two plan decisions omit reason. The JSON Schema makes reason optional; the requirement is expressed only in a local cross-field validator. The current prompt says to revise with a reason but does not explicitly restate this for the initial plan.

The cash-flow artifact has 2038 text characters. The current limit of 1000 forces three model-driven reads, including a final page of only 38 characters. All pages fit well below the effective 12000-byte response budget.
The complete table grid remains in the saved parsed output, but this run chose the /blocks/4/text representation. Do not describe the run as having verified row/column coordinates.
All inspected calls have end_turn and known usage; these failures are not output-token truncation. Cache-read counters are zero in both runs.
evidence_ready denotes host reference and body-delivery checks. This audit does not establish financial accuracy, answer completeness, or model benchmark quality.

prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.proposal: Add a short action-contract table to the planner instruction: initial plan and gap require a nonblank reason; source/query/extract/answer actions require existing requirement_ids. Include one valid source-action example using an explicitly supplied requirement ID.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.preserve: Do not fill in a missing requirement ID automatically or weaken host scope validation.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.hypothesis: This may prevent seven rejected calls seen here; actual savings are unverified and are not a counterfactual cost claim.

prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.proposal: Improve allowlisted nested-schema feedback: identify artifact_read.limit and its known maximum 1000; expose an exact bounded continuation request when pagination is needed.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.preserve: Read schema-owned field names and limits only; do not echo arbitrary rejected content or private validation context.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.hypothesis: More specific feedback may reduce repair turns; requires a new budgeted repeat to measure.

prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.proposal: Separate text character-page capacity from array item count, while preserving max_bytes, frozen artifact identity and full-body delivery accounting. The 2038-character table is a concrete acceptance case for one bounded text read.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.preserve: Do not drop the final characters or mark partial delivery complete merely to shorten the run.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.hypothesis: Could remove two text-pagination decisions in this specific trace; packet budgeting and model behavior still require a budgeted replay.

prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.proposal: If formatting failures persist, trial a reduced, closed decision wire schema through native output_config.format; record AIHubMix degradation headers and continue full host validation.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.preserve: Do not silently strip Markdown/prose or execute a recovered embedded JSON object; do not send the existing large schema unchanged.
prioritized_minimum_protocol_changes.hypothesis: Constrained output could prevent formatting failures, but gateway support, schema compilation and latency/cost require a small budgeted compatibility run.

required_followup_validation.authorization: No new model run was made in this audit. A new explicit run and shared cost budget are required to test the following hypotheses.
offline_first: Fixture checks for missing plan reason, missing requirement IDs, nested limit feedback and full 2038-character text delivery.
Retain rejection of cross-source references and incomplete body delivery.
budgeted_model_comparison: Replay the same two source-bound tasks under a new prompt/config version; preserve these runs.
Record invalid JSON, local validation, host rejection, duplicate navigation, input/output/cache tokens, elapsed time and estimated cost separately.
Review exact quotations and declared gaps; faster completion alone is not a quality pass.
